records.title: Gross Intake Ratio To The Last Grade Of Primary Education And Lower Secondary General Education, Annual
records.footnote: Data refer to the total number of new entrants into the last grade of primary education or lower secondary general education, regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population at the intended entrance age to the last grade of primary education or lower secondary general education.  The intended entrance age to the last grade is the age at which pupils would enter the grade if they had started school at the official primary entrance age, had studied full-time and had progressed without repeating or skipping a grade.
